_comment: One table, two runners: tests/js/source.test.mjs checks logic.mjs's oneVideo and tests/test_source.py checks youtube.one_video against it. The page refuses a bad source before sending it and the server refuses it again; the two must agree on what a single video is (DESIGN.md §9.34).

cases.why: a bare id is what the plan stores
with the spaces a paste brings
the ordinary watch link
copied from inside a playlist: one video, the list part ignored
the v= is not always first
the share link
the share link with a start time
music.youtube, where an audio upload usually lives
the mobile host
a short
an embed
no scheme, as a paste from the address bar can be
a playlist is not one video
nor is a channel
nor a channel by id
nor a search
another site's watch link is not ours
ten characters is not an id
twelve is not either
an id may not carry punctuation
empty is nothing to point at
and neither is prose
